/public/models/{provider}/{model}

GET /public/models/{provider}/{model}

Who may call: public, no credential.

Path parameters: provider, model.

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written, read against public_models_detail in crates/mr-server/src/public_models.rs. 404 {error:not_found} for a name the catalogue and the partner listing do not know. Latency and uptime are null below the k-floor.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "provider",
    "model",
    "partner"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "family": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "contextWindow": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "priceInputPerMillionUsd": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "priceOutputPerMillionUsd": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "partner": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "latency": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "p50Ms": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "p95Ms": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "window": {
          "const": "24h"
        }
      }
    },
    "uptime": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "5m": {
          "type": "null"
        },
        "30m": {
          "type": "null"
        },
        "1d": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    "floor": {
      "type": "integer"
    }
  }
}
